title: From Certified Pairs to a Certified Hub: Reasoner-Checked Crosswalks for the Information Exchange Standard
abstract: arXiv:2611.06628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A national digital twin was conceived as an ecosystem of twins connected through mappings to a common foundation, but the roadmap that promises to confirm those mappings are valid never says what valid means. We give the test a precise form, coherence and conservativity of the merged ontology, borrowed from logic-based alignment repair, and apply it to the Information Exchange Standard (IES), first pair by pair and then to whole hubs. Crosswalks from IES into thirteen ontologies across seven sector groups, anchored on the building ontologies BOT, Brick, and SAREF4BLDG, pass through separate stages of matching, human review, certification of each SKOS correspondence against the two class hierarchies, and reasoning with HermiT. Pair by pair, the stages catch different failures: certification alone removed all 526 conservativity violations of the raw crosswalks, review alone left 73, and together they made eleven of twelve overlapping pairs

translated_title: 从经认证的成对映射到经认证的枢纽：由推理机校验的信息交换标准交叉映射
translated_abstract: 国家数字孪生被构想为一个由多个孪生体组成、通过映射连接到共同基础的生态系统，但承诺确认这些映射有效性的路线图却从未说明“有效”究竟意味着什么。我们借鉴基于逻辑的对齐修复方法，为这一检验赋予了精确的形式——合并后本体的连贯性与保守性——并将其应用于信息交换标准（IES），先逐对检验，再扩展到整个枢纽。从IES出发、锚定于建筑本体BOT、Brick和SAREF4BLDG、通向七个行业领域组中十三个本体的交叉映射，依次经过匹配、人工审核、针对两个类层次结构对每条SKOS对应关系进行认证、以及使用HermiT进行推理等相互独立的阶段。逐对检验时，各阶段捕获的失败各不相同：仅靠认证就消除了原始交叉映射中全部526处保守性违反，仅靠审核则遗留了73处，而二者结合使十二个存在重叠的映射对中的十一个实现了连贯。
tldr: 该论文将交叉映射的有效性精确定义为合并本体的连贯性与保守性，并通过“匹配—人工审核—SKOS对应认证—HermiT推理”的分阶段流程校验信息交换标准（IES）通向十三个本体的映射，首次实现了从经认证的成对映射升级到经认证的整个枢纽。
en_tdlr: By formalizing crosswalk validity as coherence and conservativity of the merged ontology and applying a staged pipeline of matching, human review, SKOS correspondence certification, and HermiT reasoning, this work validates IES crosswalks to thirteen ontologies, elevating from certified pairs to a certified hub.
